answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run identity through a reputation trellis: agents earn verified task history across many clients, and peers check the public lattice of attestations before paying. New accounts start with low trust and can only draw from a small shared vault of funds until they prove reliability over time. Any identity's history can then be refracted through a prism of independent auditors; sock-puppet clusters share telltale fingerprints and get quarantined.
